mapper.select: select teaching_work.*,sys_user.username,sys_user.realname, sys_user.avatar, sys_user.sex, (select file_path from sys_file where sys_file.id = teaching_work.work_file) workFileKey, (select file_path from sys_file where sys_file.id = teaching_work.work_cover) coverFileKey from teaching_work left join sys_user on teaching_work.user_id = sys_user.id where sys_user.del_flag=0 and teaching_work.id = #{workId}

select a.*, a.id additionalWorkId, d.depart_id departId, sd.depart_name departName, w.id mineWorkId, w.work_name mineWorkName, w.work_status mineWorkStatus, w.work_file mineWorkUrl, w.work_cover mineWorkCover, c.score, c.comment from teaching_additional_work a join (
select #{id} as depart_id
) d on find_in_set(d.depart_id, replace(ifnull(a.work_dept,''), ' ', '')) > 0 left join sys_depart sd on sd.id = d.depart_id left join teaching_work w on w.additional_id = a.id and w.user_id = #{userId} and w.depart_id = d.depart_id left join teaching_work_correct c on c.work_id = w.id where a.status=1
and w.work_status >= 1
and (w.id is null or w.work_status < 1)
and w.work_status = #{status}
order by a.create_time desc
